_comment: Multi-session recall. Each scenario stages claims whose evidence names an event in an EARLIER session, then asks a question in a LATER one. Claim serving is tenant- and actor-scoped rather than session-scoped, so the earlier claim is reachable by construction -- what is measured is whether it is actually RETRIEVED, against the competition of every other scenario's claims in the same tenant. Predicates are the shipped global ontology's, checked against it rather than invented: `value_kind` says whether the value names an entity the seeder must create or a literal string, because the ontology types each predicate and refuses a mismatch. Frozen after the first measurement; extend with a new file rather than editing this one.
